title: Evidence for the breakdown of an Angkorian hydraulic system, and its historical implications for understanding the Khmer Empire
version: Journal of Archaeological Science: Reports 17, 195–211, DOI 10.1016/j.jasrep.2017.11.014
lineage: Peer-reviewed archaeological and hydrological reconstruction, not an eyewitness event. Early failure and its possible social consequences are modeled hypotheses; no causal claim that it forced relocation of the capital is adopted.

passages.note: Examines a 7 km embankment probably built 928–941 CE, a road on its crest and paired outlets.
Uses field observations and hydrological modeling to propose undersized outlets and probable early failure; timing and effects are interpreted.
